episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: With Kemal and Sibel's long-awaited engagement arrangements underway, a chance encounter with a familiar face puts a new spring in Kemal's step.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Füsun's secret visits become more frequent — along with her worries — and Kemal finds himself blissfully slipping into unchartered territories.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The mortality of love begins to reveal itself, when Kemal finds out that his father has been keeping a secret. Füsun receives a heartbreaking invitation.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Emotions run high at Sibel and Kemal's engagement party. While Sibel spends her time matchmaking her friends, Kemal learns that he can't have it all.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Lost in his melancholy, Kemal confesses the true nature of his time at the Merhamet Apartments. But is forgiveness enough to save his relationship?

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Füsun's invitation is veiled with heartbreak and longing, yet reveals itself to be nothing but an ulterior motive. Love is closer and further than ever.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: A newspaper column brings Kemal's shame to light, but when he is ostracized by his own friends, he discovers that there are even more secrets to uncover.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: When an opportunity presents itself, Kemal convinces his mother to make amends with her cousin. Finally true happiness seems within his grasp.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Kemal's museum of broken-hearted memories and trinkets of innocence becomes a physical dedication to the ultimate love story — a decade in the making.
